topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, reviews prior practicals, and outlines the day's learning objectives.

topics.label: Viral origins of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular oncogenes and how laboratory assays measure transformed cell phenotypes.

topics.label: Functional classification and mechanisms of cancer genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the properties of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate their molecular mechanisms using cell cycle regulators and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genomic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the causes and cellular outcomes of sequence and chromosomal instability arising from DNA repair failures, replication errors, and mitotic defects.

topics.label: Multistep tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer development and tumor progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session by referencing learning outcomes, recommending background reading, and previewing the next lecture.
